title: no comment explaining why NoRevocation is passed to verify_chain_default
description: cert.rs:67 passes &pkix_chain::NoRevocation with no explanation. A future reader will wonder why revocation is disabled when RevocationChecker is a parameter of validate_chain. Fix: add inline comment: '// Revocation is handled by the caller\'s RevocationChecker in step N above; disable pkix-chain\'s layer to avoid double-checking.'
